Commentary.Commentary: England will have to chase a target of 141 and with the firepower in their batting-line up, they will back themselves to finish the job. If the Lankans are to claim their maiden win of the England tour, they will have to pull a rabbit out of the hat. Stay tuned for the run chase.

If the Lankans failed to impress with the bat, the English certainly did so with the ball. They held back on the extras and restricted the runs. Liam Dawson delivered a truly memorable debut, taking 3 wickets with decent economy figures as well. Chris Jordan followed with three scalps of his own, while Plunkett's brace was instrumental in the Lankan batting downfall.

It seemed that the partnership of Chandimal and Rambukwella might be able to inject some life into the innings but Ramith departed afted a spurt of quick runs for 19. Chandimal managed to stick on for a while, scoring 23, but the Lankans were not able to establish any lasting partnerships and lost wickets at almost clockwork intervals.

The Lankans were quite disappointing with the bat as they struggled against the English bowlers and failed to rake in the runs. Perera was the first victim as Plunkett claimed his scalp fairly early on. Gunathilaka looked to be getting settled in but he fell to Liam Dawson five overs later for a top-scoring 26 runs.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! And Sri Lanka have been bowled out! Yorker perfectly executed on middle and leg, Pradeep, with just the last ball to play, goes for the wild slog and he misses. The stumps are shaken and that's the end for him. Just too good from Jordan, there. With that, SRI LANKA FINISH THEIR INNINGS ON 140!
NUWAN PRADEEP is the last man in.

OUT! ANOTHER ONE BITES THE DUST! Full on middle and off, Maharoof clears his front leg, makes room for himself and lofts this towards long on. He doesn't get the distance on it and it's a good catch by the substitute David Willey who judges it well to take it.
Back of a length outside off, touch short and there's some zip off the surface, Maharoof swings his bat hard at that only to miss.
Maharoof gives the charge on this fuller delivery. Gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls to the left of the bowler. No chance of a run being taken on this occasion.

Bye! Swing a miss! A length ball angled across Bandara, he looks to slog this over the leg side but misses. Maharoof calls for the run and sets off. Puts in a dive as well but had Buttler hit, he would have been gone.
Full on the stumps, Farveez drills this towards mid off. A misfield from the fielder there allows the batsmen to take a single.
CHRIS JORDAN to bowl the final over.
Shortish on middle and off, Maharoof backs away and tucks it square of the wicket on the on side for a single. That brings an end to Plunkett's spell. Finishes it with figures of 4-0-27-2.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. No run taken.
Plunkett follows Maharoof who once again tries to make room. He squeezes it out between long on and mid-wicket for a brace.
Driven towards mid off by Maharoof but will get no run for it.
Fired on the stumps, Bandara makes a little room and drills it down to long off for an easy run.
Full around off, driven towards the cover region for a run.
PLUNKETT will bowl the penultimate over.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery. End of the over.
Full outside off, driven down to mid off as Maharoof hares to the other end for a single. There is a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Farveez is well in.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, it's tucked to deep square leg. A wayward throw is fired in towards Buttler who fumbles it. Allows the batsman to take the second run comfortably.
On the pads, it's flicked away to the on side for a single.
CHAMINDA BANDARA is the next batsman in.

OUT! AND THERE GOES LANKA'S LAST HOPE! Full and around off, Chandimal hits this in the air. It's right toward extra cover where Eoin Morgan takes a good catch running to his left. Chandimal is gone and that's another wicket for the hosts.
Full and outside off, it's driven through the covers for a single.
JORDAN is back into the attack.
Length delivery outside off, Maharoof dabs it towards cover-point and takes a quick single. Just a run off Mills' final over. He's done good today.
On a length and around off, coming into the batsman, it's pushed to the covers for no run.
Around off, Maharoof goes back and defends it solidly off his back foot.
Short of a length ball around off, a slower one this time from Mills, Dinesh opens the face and taps it behind backward point for a run.
FOUR! THAT'S MURDERED! Back of a length outside off, Chandimal rocks back quickly and slashes this hard. Gets it past backward point and away to the fence for a boundary.
From around the wicket this time, Mills with a slightly shorter length delivery, Chandimal leans back and lets it be.
Maharoof shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot.
FARVEEZ MAHAROOF is the next batsman in.
OUT! Length ball outside off, Prasanna looks to run it down to third man but Plunkett finds the outside edge. It's an easy catch for Jos Buttler and it's all over as Prasanna is dismissed cheaply.
Length ball on leg, worked square leg for a single. A moment of indecision amongst the batsmen as Prasanna wants to run a second but Chandimal doesn't budge.
4 Leg byes! Full on leg, Chandimal comes down the track, looking for a big shot again but switches to a flick at the last moment. The ball hits his thigh pad and goes to the fine leg boundary line.
SIX! Half-volley on middle and leg, Chandimal comes charging down the track and lifts that one all the way over mid on for a big one!
Chandimal plays it to the point region and the batsmen manage to come back for the second.
PLUNKETT is back into the attack.
Played to point by Prasanna for no run to end the over.

WHAT ARE THE LANKANS DOING HERE? It's literally target practice out here for the home side. A slower one outside off, Chandimal gets a bottom edge which goes back towards Buttler. He fires a throw at the bowler's end as Chandimal sets off for a single. Had Buttler hit, Dinesh would have been gone. He wasn't even in the frame. Mindless running on that occasion.
Shorter once again outside off, Prasanna rides the bounces and cuts it down towards third man for one easy run.
Length ball around off, played to point for a single.
SEEKKUGE PRASANNA is the next man in to bat.

OUT! TERRIFIC STUFF FROM JAMES VINCE! England are right on the money in the field. Back of a length delivery just outside off, Rambukwella opens the face of the bat and taps it towards short third man. He sets off for a single as Vince comes charging in and collects the ball. Fires in a throw at the bowler's end and gets a direct hit. Ramith is way, way out and the third umpire confirms it. Top stuff from England in the field today.
A run out appeal against Rambukwella is referred upstairs.
Touch short around off, pulled to the leg side for one run.
MILLS is back on.
Rambukwella works it down the leg side. Two runs added to the total.
Short outside off, Chandimal square cuts it for a single.
Chandimal punches  the ball off the backfoot.
On the stumps, RR plays the paddle sweep down the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Ramith makes great use of his powerful shoulders! Shorter delivery but Rambukwella gets down the ground and smacks it through square leg and the ball races across the fence.
SIX! Full and outside off, Rambukwella lofts it through mid on. That's a big one and there is never a question as it soars all the way over the ropes for a maximum.
Loopy and shorter around off, Ramith hits it off his back foot back down the ground. Long on cuts it across as the Lankan batsmen take one.
Another leading edge! This time it's down to long off. Chandimal isn't getting it right here at all. Another full ball which goes off the leading edge down to long off. A run taken.
Quicker one around off, drilled down to long on for a single. Broke his bat in the process too.

Another leading edge! As my friend here says, and rightly so, maybe they should practice with Rangana Herath a bit in the nets. Tossed up on off, Chandimal gets a leading edge through covers as he closes the face of the blade too early. He gets a single but he should feel lucky as no fielder was stationed there.
Full and on off, Ramith drags this through square leg for one run.

Seems Roy and Vince were looking to knock each other out. Tossed up on middle and off, Rambukwella picks it up early and slogs this over mid-wicket. Roy and Vince both run to the ball at the same time. Before clashing, Roy just manages to parry the ball back in before both of them tumble across the ropes. Good stuff in the end as the batsmen are restricted to just two runs.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On middle and off, spinning in, attempts a flick but is struck on the pads and the ball goes to third man for a single. The umpire signals a leg bye.
Outside off and slightly flat, Ramith goes for a swing but is beaten again. Another occasion that Rashid has tempted him with that line.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
Outside off, Rambukwella looks to push it but is beaten.
Floated on the stumps, Rambukwella looks to sweep but gets an inside edge and is hit on the pads.
Rambukwella works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Flicked to the leg side for no run.
RAMITH RAMBUKWELLA walks in next to bat.

OUT! A HORRIBLE, HORRIBLE RUN OUT! The second run was never on, there. That was suicide. Floated around off, Shanaka mistimes this over covers. Just clears Morgan and to top it off, the Lankan batsmen try to steal the second. Roy from sweeper cover is quick on his toes, gathers the ball and fires it in to Buttler. Shanaka is way out still as the keeper knocks the bails off. Even a dive couldn't save him. Sri Lanka are in deep trouble here. Half the side is back in the hut.
A run out appeal against Shanaka is referred upstairs.
DASUN SHANAKA is the next man in.

OUT! 3 FOR DAWSON! What a debut he's having! Fired in on the stumps, Mathews clears his front leg and goes for the wild slog over mid-wicket. He misses it completely and the ball rocks the stumps. The Lankan skipper is gone and England are right on top here.

In the air but it's comfortably safe. Good stuff from Dawson. Tossed up around off, Chandimal closes the face of the bat too early and gets a leading edge. The ball is in the air but goes through safely towards long off. One run added to the scoreboard.
Fullish and drifting into the batsman, worked towards square leg for one run.
Flighted on middle, tuning in the batsman goes for the sweep shot but misses and the keeper it. The fielding side appeals but the umpire is not interested.
Full on middle and off, pushed to the cover for a single.
Full on the stumps, driven through mid on fir a single.
Outside off, Chandimal square cuts it to the off side.
Mathews has punched the ball off the backfoot for a single.
Full on middle and off, the batsman goes for a reverse sweep but the ball turns in and hits the batsman on the pads. A big appeal from the bowler but the umpire signals a leg bye.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
DINESH CHANDIMAL is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! And Mendis is gone. Second breakthrough for the debutant. Dawson is alert as he sees Mendis walking down the track. Drags his length back a bit and this gets Mendis stuck a bit. He plays it straight back to Dawson and it's a good reverse cup from the spinner.
This loopy ball is driven to long on for a single.

FOUR! BEAUTIFUL PLACEMENT AND HE GETS THE REWARD! Tossed up delivery on middle, Mathews gets into position quickly to play this. Gets down and reverse sweeps this through backward square leg to pick up a boundary.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for one run.
Tossed up on off, Angelo drives it towards the long off fielder for a comfortable run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Lovely placement. Gets it just, just over Jordan there. Loopy around off, Mendis comes way across and paddles this just over short fine leg. Jordan gives it the chase and just about manages to keep it in. Saves a run for his side as the batsmen take three runs.
Loopy and full around off, Kusal lofts this over covers. Gets two comfortable runs for it.
Floated around off, driven to long off for one.

PEACH OF A DELIVERY! What a ripper! Nice tossed up delivery around off, Mathews prods forward to defend it but is beaten hands down. Some serious leg spin on that occasion as the ball beats the outside edge of the bat. Super stuff.
Flatter and quicker on middle and off, Mendis goes back and punches it to the off side for a single.
ADIL RASHID is brought into the bowling attack.
Short ball on the stumps, Mendis pulls it to the covers.
ANGELO MATHEWS is the next batsman in.

OUT! A good beginning for the debutant Dawson! Around off, Gunathilaka can't resist the temptation and lofts it over the covers. Chris Jordan is there to pouch it and that is the end of Sri Lanka's openers!

FOUR! LUCKY RUNS! Around off, Gunathilaka swings his bat hard at this but gets a thick inside edge. The ball whizzes past the leg stump and races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Doesn't matter how the runs come, really, especially in this format.
Floated around off, driven down to long off for one run.
Tossed up on middle, the batsman goes for the reverse sweep but doesn't hit it well. Goes to short third man as a run is taken.
Floated on middle and off, Mendis flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single.
LIAM DAWSON comes into the attack.
FOUR! WHAT A SHOT! Full on middle and off, it's in the slot and Danushka can't resist going for it. Hammers it to the long on fence and it crosses it with a single bounce. Super shot!
Short and outside off, Gunathilaka gives the charge and goes for the big pull. Gets a thick top edge down towards third man for two runs.
FOUR! DRIVEN AND DRIVEN WELL! Overpitched outside off, Gunathilaka leans into this one and drives it through the covers for a boundary.
Wide! On a length and way outside off, it's signalled as a wide.
Short of a length delivery around off, it's pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball around off, Kusal stands his ground and manages to get this over mid on. Didn't get all of it but will get a couple for it.

SIX! BAD BALL AND HE'S PAID THE PRICE! A nice hit from Mendis as well. Full toss on middle and leg, Mendis gets down to this and slogs this high. Clears the mid-wicket fence with ease and gets a biggie.
CHRIS JORDAN returns.
Length ball outside off, punched to point.
FOUR! Gunathilaka finds the gap! Full outside off, driven through cover point to the fence. First boundary for the batsman!
Fuller ball on leg, worked off the pads to backward square leg.
Mendis goes after a wide one but misses.
Fuller outside off, Gunathilaka attempts to scoop it but is hit low on the pads. There is a near run out but the fielders don't appeal.
Length ball outside off, Gunathilaka guides it to third man for a couple.
Leg bye! On leg, it goes off the southpaw's thigh pad as he goes for the flick. A leg bye taken to end the over.
Low full toss on middle and off, clipped through square leg for a couple of easy runs.
On the pads, Kusal tucks it to square leg and runs hard to the other end. A shy from the fielder at the bowler's end but Mendis is well in. Single taken.

Wide! Seems a little harsh but that was a sharp one from Mills. Wake up call for Mendis. Banged in short on leg, Mendis ducks to let it go over him. It's a little too high it seems as the umpire signals it as a wide.
Another length ball on middle and off, angling slightly away from the batsman this time, Mendis defends it into the ground in front of him.
Length ball on middle and off, Mendis dabs this straight to cover-point.
Length delivery just outside off, Gunathilaka with soft hands, taps it gently to the off side and scampers to the other end to complete a quick run.
KUSAL MENDIS walks in at No.3.

OUT! Plunkett strikes early! Short ball on middle, Perera looks to pull it but mistimes his shot and gets a top edge. The ball is flighted to fine leg and debutant Tymal Mills goes in for a comfortable catch.
Full ball on middle, worked to mid-wicket for a couple.
Full ball outisde, Perera punches the ball to the covers. A run out attempt is made but the umpire doesn't go for it.
Length ball on leg, Perera tucks it to backward sqare leg for a couple.
Short ball of middle and leg, Perera steps back and pulls it through mid on for a brace.
Length ball of middle and off, punched back to the bowler.
LIAM PLUNKETT into the attack.
Length ball straying on the pads, Kusal looks to flick this away but is rapped on the pads. A leg bye is taken as the ball rolls to the on side. End of the over.
On a length outside off, it's played towards point.
FOUR! FIRST BOUNDARY OF THE INNINGS! Fuller and outside off, Perera smashes this over the cover region. Clears the infield comfortably and sends the ball across the ropes to pick up a boundary.

IN THE AIR... AND JUST SAFE! A flying attempt from the English skipper there. Flew just past him. Back of a length delivery around off, Perera stays back and with an angled bat, hits this towards backward point. A superman-like dive from Morgan to his left but it just wasn't enough. Whizzed past him as the batsmen take two runs.

Full on middle and off, Gunathilaka pushes it to mid on and sets off for a quick single. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Danushka dives in but had that hit, it would have been a close call. Single completed.
Mills steaming in, starts off with a fullish length delivery around off, Gunathilaka comes a little forward and slices it to backward point.
TYMAL MILLS will share the new ball.
Length ball around off, Gunathilaka drives it to mid on for a single.
Length ball on the pads, Perera pulls it to square leg for a single.
Fullish ball on the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Short ball outside leg, Perera looks to play it but is beaten by the bounce. The umpire signals a wide.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Fuller ball outisde off, driven to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Perera mistimes his cut and edges it to the off side.

We are all set to get underway as the players and the umpires are out in the middle. KUSAL PERERA and DANUSHKA GUNATHILAKA will open the innings for Sri Lanka. CHRIS JORDAN will lead the English bowling charge. Let's go...

Sri Lanka XI - Kusal Perera, Danushka Gunathilaka, Kusal Mendis, Dinesh Chandimal(w), Angelo Mathews(c), Dasun Shanaka, Seekkuge Prasanna, Ramith Rambukwella, Farveez Maharoof, Nuwan Pradeep, Chaminda Bandara.
England XI - Jason Roy, James Vince, Jonny Bairstow, Eoin Morgan(c), Jos Buttler(w), Sam Billings, Liam Dawson, Liam Plunkett, Adil Rashid, Chris Jordan, Tymal Mills.
SRI LANKA WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT FIRST!

Sri Lanka though, despite being dominated, have put in some very good performances. They have a relatively new and young side and this would have been a good learning experience for them. They will want to push just a little harder and salvage some pride with a win here today. Hello and welcome for this exciting contest between these two teams. Stay tuned as the toss is about to come up shortly.

After an entertaining Test and ODI series, we now move on to what will be a one-off bout. A single T20 game to end Sri Lanka's long and grueling, yet entertaining tour of England. The Lankans have been battered and bruised in the Test and 50-over format by the Englishmen. The hosts have been clinical in their performances and have showcased their class and ability to the Islanders.
